sources.snippet: SmolLM2 Table of Contents Model Summary Evaluation Examples Limitations Training License Citation Model Summary SmolLM2 is a family of compact language models available in three size: 135M, 360M, and 1.7B parameters. They are capable of solving a wide range of tasks while being lightweight enough to run on-device.
